_readme: Agency issuer ratings, looked up 2026-10-21 AFTER config/grade.json was frozen. A rating stays in force until the agency acts, so an older last_action can still be today's rating. last_action = date of the newest agency action found (from the source shown). as_of = date someone saw the rating on the agency's own site; null means not yet confirmed there.

sp.source: Investing.com report on S&P's Norfolk Southern action, 2025-07-29: 'Union Pacific maintains its A- rating'. No S&P action on Union Pacific found; check disclosure.spglobal.com, including any CreditWatch tied to the merger

fitch.source: Fitch Ratings entity page for Union Pacific Corporation: 'Ratings (15-Jul-2026): Long-term A-, Short-term F1', seen by Pooja 2026-10-21. Fitch placed UNP on Rating Watch Positive on 2025-07-29 after the merger announcement; current watch status not shown on the card

UNP.note: Pending Norfolk Southern merger (closing expected late 2027) could move the rating either way.
